description: Request a spending budget for specific operations. Ask only for the operations and amount the task needs: the user sees the exact scope, caps and purpose, and calls outside it are refused. The approval link goes to the user, not to you.

email.description: The user's email. Needed only if you connected without signing in: Gluo sends the approval there.

purpose.description: One sentence on what the calls are for, shown to the user

name: request_budget
title: Ask the user for an API budget
